welcome: Put your bedroll down anywhere. Home Valley is the easy choice. The steps tick off as you do them, in any order. For the last one, find a survivor in the ruins, clear any monsters away from them (a frightened survivor will not talk), and ask them to join you while you have a free Bunk Bed at home.
water: The forge needs the Forge Plans blueprint (in an outpost ruin) or Crafting level 3. Build the Water Purifier touching the water's edge, then select an empty bottle and click the purifier.
mouths: Click water with the Fishing Rod, then click again when it bites. Cook the catch at a campfire. Settlers eat from storage chests, so put food in a chest and wait for one to get hungry.
hold: Raids start on day 2 and come every other night between 19:00 and 23:00. Walls, a gate and a guard post first, then wait for night.
trade: Travelling merchants turn up by the road from day 2. Talk to one and choose Trade. Sell anything, then buy anything.
explore: The name of each region shows at the top of the screen as you walk into it. Supply crates sit in ruins, wrecked convoys and raider camps.
note: Read the note in your bag first. The Depot Office is a ruin in the Scrapyard, south of the middle of the map. The crate in it holds the Brass Tag and the Dispatch Slip. Read the slip.
pump: The Pump House is in the Toxic Marsh, to the south-east. Take something for radiation (Rad tabs or Rad-Away) and do not drink the water. The ledger is in a crate inside.
signal: The Ash Tower is in the Ashlands, to the north-east. The bunker's radio room crate opens for the Brass Tag in your bag. Listen to the tape by right-clicking it.
stairs: The stairs down are inside the Ash Tower bunker and open once Chapter One is done. The Spine is a long dark tunnel with three relay panels along it; use each one. Husks nest on the way. The hatch at the far end opens once all three relays are running.
stranger: Mara Quill can turn up by a road from day 2. With Exploring 2 you can look at her boots and see she is lying, call her out, and walk into Greybridge Depot armed and warned. If you go along with her, you are taken and wake in a cage with your gear gone. There is a shiv in the cage: use it on the cage door. Your pack is under a rotten blanket nearby. Varro calls his guards, drops the act at a third of his health, and goes down on one knee near the end. Spare him, take his cache, or finish him. He remembers.
lamplighter: Odile is in the lighthouse at Lamp Cove, the first place you reach on the coast. She only answers what you ask, so ask everything. The Manifest Case is in the Wreck Fields, which are under water at high tide. The tide readout at the top of the screen says when it turns. Bring the case back to her.
quorum: Each survivor gives you their Tag Card when you finish their favour (see the People page). You need six. There are five ways past the Listeners at Chapel Row: fight them; promise to return the tags (needs Listener reputation 2); lie to them (works with Listener reputation 1, otherwise it becomes a fight); tell them the truth (needs Memory 3, after The Lamplighter); or crawl through the culvert at low tide. The console is at the Breakwater beyond.
ch3_case: Talk to Marta (at your camp if she joined you, otherwise where you found her) and choose Ask about the case. She will deny it. Memory 4, having been honest with her about the note, trust of 2 or more, or pushing her will all get it out of her. Open it with her, or later by right-clicking it in your bag. If Marta is gone for good, walk to your camp and look under her empty bunk.
ch3_radio: Talk to Priya Nair (at your camp or her shack in the marsh) and choose Ask about the radio. Asking her to stop means fewer Listeners come next. Telling her to keep answering means more.
ch3_listeners: Be at your camp in the Wastes between 19:00 and 23:00, at least six hours after talking to Priya. If the Listeners like you (Listener reputation 2, or 1 if Priya went quiet) they come in peace. Otherwise it is a raid. Either way, the Cantor is then waiting in the chapel at Chapel Row on the coast: go down the Ash Tower stairs and through the Spine. You can talk him down with Memory 5, with a valley that can take in 20 or more sleepers (the Long Table box in the settlement panel, B), or with Listener reputation 3. Lying, or a weak answer, starts a boss fight. He calls more Listeners at half health and goes down on one knee near the end.
ch3_table: A Table needs camp level 2 (Outpost). Build it in your camp, then talk to any of the ten who live with you and choose Call everyone to the table. If none of them live with you, just walk up to the table. The choice you make there carries into Chapter Four.
